description: This PHP file contains a test class 'ActivitiesCest' that automates acceptance tests for the Activities module in SuiteCRM. It includes setup of fake data, navigation, creation, verification of certain field visibility (such as 'due date'), and cleanup steps such as deleting records.

classes.name: ActivitiesCest
classes.description: A class defining acceptance test scenarios for the Activities module in SuiteCRM, focusing on verifying the visibility of the due date in the activities subpanel, including setup and cleanup steps.

methods.name: _before
methods.description: Setup method executed before each test to initialize fake data generator and seed random data

methods.name: testSeeDueDateSubpanelView
methods.description: Test case that creates an account and call, verifies the due date is visible in the activities subpanel, then performs cleanup by deleting created records
